g.text: Go2 fixed-task pilot | Performance versus recorded elapsed time

text.style: font-size: 8.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #444444

g.text: COMPLETED FIXED PROTOCOL | Separate training seeds; known development cases
Points: rounds 0–4; each seed has 3 known-case evaluations per round.
Lines break for NOT_RUN, incomplete evaluation, missing cost or no successful time. Failures are never timed as completions.
Method elapsed intervals + one shared preparation interval; loading/setup and recovery downtime are excluded.
Successful-time means are conditional on success; read with the success panel. No seed pooling or confidence intervals.
Follower reference: the same 3 fixed cases once, no training; repeated guide, not extra seed replicates. Cost is separate.
